notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature with power two or greater, or have one exiled by Yannik.
description:
Activate Emiel by paying {3}, blinking Yannik.
When Yannik leaves the battlefield, all creatures exiled with it return to the battlefield.
When Yannik enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling another creature you control with power two or greater and putting at least two +1/+1 counters on Cryptic Trilobite.
Activate Cryptic Trilobite's first ability twice by removing two +1/+1 counters from it, adding {C}{C}{C}{C} that can only be spent to activate abilities.
Repeat.
